_comment: Everything both stores need, in one file. Top level keys that carry a `name` are locales; store-kit finds them that way, so adding a language means adding a block. Keys starting with an underscore are notes and are never sent anywhere.

shared._appleIdNote: Numeric App Store id. Not needed to push, useful in generated docs and links.

play._comment: ASC locale -> Play locale. A locale block with no entry here is not sent to Play.

inAppPurchases._comment: Product ids are permanent: neither store lets one be renamed or reused once created, and RevenueCat holds the same string. `term` drives everything else, including the Play base plan id, which defaults to `<term>-autorenew`.

trialOffer._offerIdNote: Defaults to free-trial-<days>d. Part of the RevenueCat identifier on Play, so set it explicitly if the catalog already names one.

play._note: Optional. basePlanId defaults to `monthly-autorenew`, period to P1M.

appPrivacy._comment: What the app collects, for the App Privacy questionnaire.
appPrivacy.tracking: This app does not track users.

reviewNotes._comment: Shown to the reviewer. Say how to reach the paid surface without an account.
